title: FB-034 fix PowerShell analysis wrapper default target
summary: Fix FR-046 by making the PowerShell analyzer wrapper target the promoted ops/pipeline/engine tree and fail when the requested analysis path is missing.
reason: Worker finding W10-MED-002 showed check_powershell_analysis.ps1 resolved the repository root as ops, defaulted to the removed ops/engine path, and exited success when that target was absent.
behavior_before: The wrapper defaulted to a removed path and printed a skipped message with exit code 0 when the target did not exist.
behavior_after: The wrapper resolves the repository root from ops/scripts/dev, defaults to ops/pipeline/engine, resolves relative paths against the repository root, and exits nonzero when the requested target does not exist.
manual_validation: Bundled PowerShell 7 default wrapper invocation reached ops/pipeline/engine and exited 0 with the existing PSScriptAnalyzer-not-installed warning.
Bundled PowerShell 7 missing-path invocation exited 1 as expected.

PowerShell parser check passed; bundled PowerShell 7 default wrapper invocation reached ops/pipeline/engine and exited 0 with PSScriptAnalyzer-not-installed warning; missing-path invocation exited 1 as expected.
